Every lab now marks its own output.
We prove the whole pipeline.

The EU Transparency Code of Practice (final 10 Jun 2026, adequacy adopted 8–9 Jul) requires digitally signed, timestamped, tamper-evident metadata. Cryptographic signing is now the endorsed compliance primitive. For non-signatories and deployers of open-weights models, the burden shifts to showing adequate alternative means. This evidence pack is that equivalence — signed, refutable, ledger-backed, and independently verifiable.

What the pack is

A machine-readable bundle proving that an AI system's transparency and content-marking obligations are met by measured evidence, not by a supplier's self-attestation. Every artefact is: Ed25519-signed, hash-chained, append-only, and carries a Wilson 95% confidence interval with its n — or is explicitly marked UNMEASURED.

  • Assessment record — the measurement result per control objective, `satisfied` / `not-satisfied`, with the evidence trail.
  • Chain receipt — the signed, chronology-preserving ChainResult with Fisher–Rao distance and permitted-radius verdict.
  • OSCAL 1.1.0 artifact — the audit world's native format; FedRAMP-accepted, CI-friendly.
  • Refutation ledger — a public, never-silently-edited history of every correction and delta, dated.

Why it satisfies "adequate alternative means"

Code requirementHow this pack meets it
Digitally signed Ed25519 signature per artefact, verifiable offline against a published public key.
Timestamped Every artefact carries a UTC timestamp in its signed envelope; the append-only chain cannot be backdated.
Tamper-evident Hash-chained receipts; changing any byte breaks the chain and the signature. Auditable, replayable, refutable.
Third-party, not vendor self-attestation Measurement is independent and neutral — the marking is done by the vendor; the verification of the pipeline is ours.

The measurement discipline (why it holds)

  • Every figure carries its n and its interval, or is marked UNMEASURED. No number without a run.
  • Deadline-anchored. Enforcement applies since 2 Aug 2026; the pre-existing-systems marking deadline is 2 Dec 2026.
  • Deltas are published, never silently edited. A self-caught under-report disclosed with a dated note is a credibility asset; a quiet edit is not.
